NOSE-01.name: Nose cone, PETG tangent ogive 12.75 in + 2 in shoulder
NOSE-01.note: 0.8 mm walls; shoulder 1.6 mm. Held by 3 x M3 so the airbrake latch stays reachable.
NOSE-01.role: Printed PETG tangent ogive, 0.8 mm wall. Its 2 in shoulder slides into the nose ring. Three printed bosses inside take the retention screws.

NOSE-SCREW.name: M3 x 8 button-head screw (nose retention)
NOSE-SCREW.role: Hold the nose on through the nose ring. Take them out to lift the nose off and reach the airbrake latch.

TUBE-01.name: Nose ring, LOC 3.9 in kraft tube (71 mm)
TUBE-01.role: The 71 mm piece of body tube between the nose and the petals. The fixed hinge halves are bonded to it, and it is glued 19 mm onto the airbrake sleeve.

PETAL-HINGE-F.name: Petal hinge, fixed half with 90 deg stop
PETAL-HINGE-F.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
PETAL-HINGE-F.role: Printed CF-nylon leaf bonded to the nose ring with two knuckles. Its stop block catches the open petal at 90° against ~3 N of air load.

PETAL-01.name: Airbrake petal, 90 deg quadrant cut from the tube (149 mm)
PETAL-01.note: Seal edges with thin CA; 2 oz fibreglass inside.
PETAL-01.role: A 90° quadrant cut from the body tube, 150 mm long. Flush with the skin on the way up; springs out to 90° at apogee so the rocket falls tail-first and stable at ~18 m/s.

PETAL-HINGE-M.name: Petal hinge, moving half
PETAL-HINGE-M.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
PETAL-HINGE-M.role: Printed CF-nylon leaf bonded to the petal's forward edge; its middle knuckle turns on the hinge pin.

PETAL-PIN.name: Petal hinge pin, 1.6 mm stainless, 34 mm
PETAL-PIN.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
PETAL-PIN.role: 1.6 mm stainless pin through the three knuckles; it also carries the torsion spring.

PETAL-SPRING.name: Petal torsion spring, ~0.1 N m
PETAL-SPRING.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
PETAL-SPRING.role: About 0.1 N·m of preload that flips the petal open in under 0.2 s when the latch lets go.

PETAL-TAB.name: Petal latch tab
PETAL-TAB.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
PETAL-TAB.role: Printed tab bonded inside the petal's aft edge. It pokes through the sleeve slot, and its notch is where the latch-ring finger sits.

CPL-01.name: Airbrake sleeve, LOC 3.9 in coupler (189 mm), latch slots + 4 lightening windows
CPL-01.role: 189 mm LOC coupler that holds the nose ring and the recovery section together across the petal band. Windows under each petal save 33 g; slots let the petal tabs through.

LATCH-RING.name: Airbrake latch ring with 4 fingers
LATCH-RING.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
LATCH-RING.role: Printed ring inside the sleeve with one finger per petal. Turning it a few degrees slides all four fingers out of the tab notches at once.

SERVO-LATCH.name: Airbrake-latch micro servo (4.3 g)
SERVO-LATCH.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
SERVO-LATCH.role: 4.3 g micro servo (pin 7) that turns the latch ring at apogee.

HORN-LATCH.name: Servo horn
HORN-LATCH.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
HORN-LATCH.role: Arm on the latch servo's output shaft.

LATCH-LINK.name: Servo-to-latch-ring link
LATCH-LINK.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
LATCH-LINK.role: Wire link with ball ends from the horn to the latch ring's lug.

LATCH-SERVO-BRKT.name: Latch servo mount, bonded to the sleeve
LATCH-SERVO-BRKT.budget: Top airbrake petals, hinges, springs, latch servo
LATCH-SERVO-BRKT.role: Printed block that bonds the latch servo to the solid strip of sleeve between two windows.

TUBE-02.name: Recovery section, kraft tube (223 mm) with door cut-out
TUBE-02.role: 223 mm of body tube between the petals and the avionics bay. It holds the chute bay and has the door cut out of it.

DOOR-01.name: Chute door, cut from the tube
DOOR-01.role: 105 x 70 mm panel cut from the tube. It is latched shut in a normal flight; in an abort it swings open and the chute is pushed out.

DOOR-HINGE-F.name: Door hinge, fixed half
DOOR-HINGE-F.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
DOOR-HINGE-F.role: Printed hinge leaf on the tube at the door's aft edge.

DOOR-HINGE-M.name: Door hinge, moving half
DOOR-HINGE-M.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
DOOR-HINGE-M.role: Printed hinge leaf on the door.

DOOR-PIN.name: Door hinge pin, 1.6 mm stainless
DOOR-PIN.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
DOOR-PIN.role: 1.6 mm stainless pin through the door hinge.

DOOR-LUG.name: Door latch lug
DOOR-LUG.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
DOOR-LUG.role: Printed lug inside the door's forward edge; the chute-latch pin passes through it to hold the door shut.

TUBE-03.name: Switch band, kraft tube (25 mm): key, switch, static ports, leg pin
TUBE-03.role: 25 mm ring of body tube glued around the middle of the avionics coupler. It carries the arm key, main switch, leg-release pin and three static ports.

CPL-02.name: Avionics-bay coupler, LOC 3.9 in (160 mm)
CPL-02.role: 160 mm LOC coupler that is the avionics bay. It joins the recovery section to the aft tube.

TUBE-04.name: Aft airframe, kraft tube (731 mm), fin and leg slots
TUBE-04.role: 731 mm of body tube from the avionics bay to the tail. Slotted for the fins and leg clevises.

LINER-AFT.name: Aft carbon liner, 2 wraps 200 gsm + epoxy (6 in), slotted
LINER-AFT.role: Two wraps of carbon cloth inside the last 6 in. They stiffen the tube where the fins, legs and thrust plate load it.

FIN-01.name: Fin, 3/32 in aircraft birch ply, through-the-wall
FIN-01.note: Round the leading edge; 6 mm epoxy fillets.
FIN-01.role: 3/32 in birch ply, through the wall. Keeps the rocket pointed while it coasts up with the motor out.

FIN-FILLET.name: Epoxy root fillet, 6 mm
FIN-FILLET.role: 6 mm epoxy fillets on both sides of each fin root; they make the joint strong.

RECOV-BH.name: Recovery bulkhead, 1/8 in ply, U-bolt + cable holes
RECOV-BH.role: 1/8 in ply disc glued in the tube at the top of the chute bay. It carries the U-bolt and separates the bay from the airbrake sleeve.

UBOLT.name: M4 U-bolt, shock-cord anchor
UBOLT.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
UBOLT.role: M4 U-bolt: the strong point the shock cord and chute hang from.

NUT-M4.name: M4 nut
NUT-M4.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
NUT-M4.role: Clamp the U-bolt to the bulkhead.

CHUTE-NOMEX.name: Nomex chute protector (9 in), wrapped
CHUTE-NOMEX.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
CHUTE-NOMEX.role: Fire-resistant blanket wrapped around the folded chute, in case the motors' heat reaches it.

CHUTE-30.name: Backup main parachute, 30 in nylon, Z-folded
CHUTE-30.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
CHUTE-30.role: Nylon chute, Z-folded to about 54 x 74 mm. Used only in an abort; it brings 1.4 kg down at about 5-6 m/s.

SHOCK-CORD.name: Kevlar shock cord, 4.5 m, flaked and bundled
SHOCK-CORD.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
SHOCK-CORD.role: 4.5 m of Kevlar, flaked and bundled. It absorbs the snatch when the chute opens.

SHOCK-CORD-RUN.name: Shock cord to U-bolt and riser
SHOCK-CORD-RUN.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
SHOCK-CORD-RUN.role: The ends of the shock cord: one tied to the U-bolt, one to the chute's riser.

EJECT-PLATE.name: Ejector plate, 2 mm ply
EJECT-PLATE.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
EJECT-PLATE.role: Thin ply plate on two springs that pushes the chute pack toward the door.

EJECT-SPRING.name: Ejector compression spring, ~20 N each
EJECT-SPRING.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
EJECT-SPRING.role: Compression springs, ~20 N each, that throw the chute out when the door opens.

EJECT-CUP.name: Ejector spring seat
EJECT-CUP.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
EJECT-CUP.role: Printed cups bonded to the far wall that locate the ejector springs.

SERVO-CHUTE.name: Chute-latch micro servo (4.3 g)
SERVO-CHUTE.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
SERVO-CHUTE.role: 4.3 g micro servo (pin 29) under the bulkhead. It pulls the latch pin to open the door.

HORN-CHUTE.name: Servo horn
HORN-CHUTE.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door

CHUTE-PIN.name: Chute-latch pin, 1.8 mm steel
CHUTE-PIN.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
CHUTE-PIN.role: 1.8 mm steel pin through the door lug. Pulling it releases the door.

CHUTE-LINK.name: Servo-to-pin link
CHUTE-LINK.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
CHUTE-LINK.role: Wire link from the servo horn to the latch pin.

CHUTE-SERVO-BRKT.name: Chute servo mount
CHUTE-SERVO-BRKT.budget: Backup chute + shock cord + spring/servo door
CHUTE-SERVO-BRKT.role: Printed block that bonds the servo to the bulkhead.

AV-LID-F.name: Avionics bay forward lid, 1/8 in ply
AV-LID-F.role: 1/8 in ply disc that closes the top of the bay; the GPS patch hangs under it.

AV-LID-A.name: Avionics bay aft lid, 1/8 in ply, grommet + cable holes
AV-LID-A.role: 1/8 in ply disc that closes the bottom of the bay, with the harness grommet and lidar-cable hole.

AV-LID-RING-F.name: Lid locating ring, PETG
AV-LID-RING-F.role: Printed ring that keys the forward lid into the coupler.

AV-LID-RING-A.name: Lid locating ring, PETG
AV-LID-RING-A.role: Printed ring that keys the aft lid into the coupler.

AV-ROD.name: M3 nylon threaded rod, 175 mm
AV-ROD.role: M3 nylon rods that clamp the two lids to the coupler and guide the sled.

NUT-M3.name: M3 nylon wing nut
NUT-M3.role: Nylon wing nuts on the rod ends; finger-tight so the bay opens on the field.

AV-SLED.name: Avionics sled, 1/8 in lite ply
AV-SLED.role: 1/8 in lite-ply board everything electronic mounts to. It slides out on the rods.

AV-SLED-TUBE.name: Sled rod guide, printed
AV-SLED-TUBE.role: Printed tubes along the sled edges that ride on the threaded rods.

STANDOFF-3.name: Nylon standoff 3 mm
STANDOFF-3.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
STANDOFF-3.role: 3 mm nylon spacers under the boards.

PERFBOARD.name: Perfboard 54 x 120 mm (flight computer carrier)
PERFBOARD.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
PERFBOARD.role: 54 x 120 mm perfboard carrying the Teensy, sensors, regulator and pyro channels. Becomes a PCB once the design is frozen.

HEADERS.name: Female header strips 2 x 24
HEADERS.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
HEADERS.role: Sockets the Teensy plugs into, so it can be swapped.

TEENSY-41.name: PJRC Teensy 4.1 (600 MHz, microSD log)
TEENSY-41.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
TEENSY-41.role: The flight computer: a 600 MHz microcontroller that runs the 1 kHz state estimator and re-plans the landing burn 50 times a second, logging everything to its microSD card.

IMU-BMI088.name: Bosch BMI088 IMU breakout (Seeed Grove), on the axis
IMU-BMI088.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
IMU-BMI088.role: Accelerometer (±24 g) and gyro. Mounted near the rocket's axis so it reads attitude and acceleration cleanly.

STANDOFF-5.name: IMU standoffs (4)
STANDOFF-5.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
STANDOFF-5.role: Four 5 mm standoffs that mount the IMU rigidly.

BARO-BMP390.name: Bosch BMP390 barometer breakout (Adafruit)
BARO-BMP390.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
BARO-BMP390.role: Measures air pressure for altitude through the whole flight, through the static ports.

BARO-FOAM.name: Open-cell foam over the barometer
BARO-FOAM.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
BARO-FOAM.role: Open-cell foam that shields the barometer from gusts and light.

BUCK-5V.name: Pololu D24V30F5 5 V 3 A buck
BUCK-5V.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
BUCK-5V.role: Steps the 2S battery down to 5 V for the Teensy, lidar and micro servos.

FET-AO3400.name: AO3400A pyro MOSFET (SOT-23)
FET-AO3400.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
FET-AO3400.role: Switch the two landing-motor igniters, fired together.

CAP-1000U.name: 1000 uF servo-rail capacitor
CAP-1000U.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
CAP-1000U.role: 1000 µF reservoir that keeps servo current spikes from browning out the computer.

BUZZER.name: 11 mm piezo buzzer
BUZZER.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
BUZZER.role: Beeps the arm state and status on the pad and helps you find the rocket.

JST-GH.name: JST-GH locking header
JST-GH.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
JST-GH.role: JST-GH headers for servos, sensors and the pyro leads; they can't shake loose.

SERVO-LEGPIN.name: Leg-release micro servo (4.3 g)
SERVO-LEGPIN.role: 4.3 g micro servo (pin 28) that pulls the leg-release pin at 12 m.

LEG-RELEASE-PIN.name: Leg-release pin, 1.5 mm steel
LEG-RELEASE-PIN.role: 1.5 mm steel pin poking out of the switch band. The Kevlar loop that holds the folded legs hooks over it.

LEGPIN-LINK.name: Servo-to-pin link
LEGPIN-LINK.role: Wire link from the servo horn to the release pin.

LEGPIN-BRKT.name: Leg-release servo mount
LEGPIN-BRKT.role: Printed block that bonds the leg-release servo to the coupler wall.

LIPO-2S.name: 2S 450 mAh LiPo
LIPO-2S.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
LIPO-2S.role: 450 mAh, 7.4 V pack that powers everything for about 15 minutes of pad time.

GPS-M9N.name: u-blox NEO-M9N GPS breakout (SparkFun)
GPS-M9N.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
GPS-M9N.role: u-blox NEO-M9N; gives the sideways velocity the landing burn cancels.

GPS-PATCH.name: 25 mm ceramic GPS patch antenna, under the forward lid
GPS-PATCH.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
GPS-PATCH.role: 25 mm ceramic patch under the forward lid, facing the sky.

LORA-RFM95W.name: HopeRF RFM95W 915 MHz LoRa breakout
LORA-RFM95W.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
LORA-RFM95W.role: 915 MHz telemetry link to the ground station.

LORA-ANT.name: 915 MHz quarter-wave wire antenna (82 mm)
LORA-ANT.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery

ARM-KEY-SW.name: Arm key switch (pyro rail), panel-mount through the band
ARM-KEY-SW.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
ARM-KEY-SW.role: Physical switch in the igniter power line. Key out means the landing motor cannot fire, whatever the software does.

ARM-KEY.name: Arm key (remove before flight on the bench)
ARM-KEY.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery
ARM-KEY.role: Removable key; it goes in only at the pad.

MAIN-SW.name: Main power toggle switch
MAIN-SW.budget: Avionics bay: boards, sensors, radio, battery

GROMMET.name: Harness grommet, aft lid
GROMMET.role: Printed TPU grommet where the servo and pyro wiring leaves the bay.

HARNESS-AFT.name: Servo / pyro harness to the motor bay (bundle)
HARNESS-AFT.role: Servo and pyro wiring from the avionics bay down the tube wall to the motor bay.

CABLE-LIDAR.name: Lidar cable, along the 315 deg leg line
CABLE-LIDAR.role: Runs from the avionics bay to the lidar along the 315° leg line.

CABLE-FWD.name: Airbrake / chute servo cable
CABLE-FWD.role: Runs the airbrake-latch and chute-latch servo leads up from the avionics bay through the bulkhead.

MOTOR-F52C.name: AeroTech F52C ascent motor (29 x 111 mm, 81 g)
MOTOR-F52C.role: AeroTech F52C, 66 N·s. Lit by the launch controller; flies the rocket to ~226 ft.

MOTOR-F25W.name: AeroTech F25W landing motor (29 x 98 mm, 97 g)
MOTOR-F25W.note: Two igniters, fired by the flight computer.
MOTOR-F25W.role: AeroTech F25W, 71 N·s. Lit by the flight computer at ~15 m on the way down; its thrust fades naturally ('strong, then simmer').

F25W-SPACER.name: F25W 13 mm spacer (both nozzles exit together)
F25W-SPACER.role: 13 mm printed spacer so both nozzles end at the same height (the F25W is shorter).

SLEEVE-29.name: 29 mm motor sleeve, kraft motor-mount tube, 113 mm (high-temp epoxy)
SLEEVE-29.role: 113 mm kraft motor tube bonded into the inner gimbal ring; the motors slide in from the bottom.

SLEEVE-CAP.name: Sleeve thrust cap, aluminium (igniter-lead hole)
SLEEVE-CAP.role: Aluminium cap on the top of each sleeve. The motor pushes on it, and the igniter leads pass through its hole.

CLIP-RET.name: Spring-steel clip retainer + M2 screw
CLIP-RET.role: Spring-steel clip that hooks under the motor's aft end so it can't slide out.

CLIP-RET-L.name: Spring-steel clip retainer + M2 screw
CLIP-RET-L.role: Same clip on the landing-motor sleeve.

IGN-CONN.name: Landing-igniter 2-pin locking connector
IGN-CONN.role: Locking 2-pin connector for the landing igniters; it stays unplugged until the pad.

GIMBAL-INNER.name: Gimbal inner ring (holds both sleeves), CF-nylon
GIMBAL-INNER.role: Holds both sleeves. Tilts about the X axis on the X pins; servo B drives it.

GIMBAL-MIDDLE.name: Gimbal middle ring, CF-nylon
GIMBAL-MIDDLE.role: Carries the inner ring. Tilts about the Y axis on the Y pins; servo A drives it.

GIMBAL-POST.name: Gimbal yoke post (outer frame), CF-nylon
GIMBAL-POST.role: Fixed post from the thrust plate that holds one Y pin.

GIMBAL-POST-B.name: Gimbal yoke post (outer frame), CF-nylon
GIMBAL-POST-B.role: The matching post on the other side.

PIN-X.name: Gimbal pin, 3 mm steel (X axis)
PIN-X.role: 3 mm steel pivots between the inner and middle rings.

PIN-Y.name: Gimbal pin, 3 mm steel (Y axis)
PIN-Y.role: 3 mm steel pivots between the middle ring and the yoke posts.

THRUST-PLATE.name: Thrust plate, 1/8 in ply ring
THRUST-PLATE.role: 1/8 in ply ring bonded in the tube. All motor thrust ends up here and goes into the airframe.

THRUST-PLATE-AL.name: Thrust plate, 1 mm aluminium ring
THRUST-PLATE-AL.role: 1 mm aluminium ring on the ply that spreads the post and servo loads.

SERVO-GIMBAL-A.name: KST X08H gimbal servo A (pitch, drives middle ring)
SERVO-GIMBAL-A.role: KST X08H (pin 2) that tilts the middle ring: pitch.

HORN-GIMBAL-A.name: Servo horn (10 mm)
HORN-GIMBAL-A.role: 10 mm horn, about a 2:1 servo-to-gimbal ratio.

PUSHROD-A.name: 1.5 mm steel pushrod with ball links
PUSHROD-A.role: 1.5 mm steel rod with ball links from servo A to the middle-ring lug.

SERVO-BRKT-A.name: Gimbal servo bracket, CF-nylon
SERVO-BRKT-A.role: Printed bracket on the thrust plate.

SERVO-GIMBAL-B.name: KST X08H gimbal servo B (yaw, drives inner ring)
SERVO-GIMBAL-B.role: KST X08H (pin 3) that tilts the inner ring: yaw.

PUSHROD-B.name: 1.5 mm steel pushrod with ball links
PUSHROD-B.role: Ball-link rod from servo B to the inner-ring lug.

SERVO-BRKT-B.name: Gimbal servo bracket, CF-nylon
SERVO-BRKT-B.role: Printed bracket on the thrust plate.

PADDLE-R.name: Throttle paddle, alumina-silicate ceramic 20 x 28 x 4
PADDLE-R.role: Machinable ceramic, 20 x 28 x 4 mm. Swings into the landing motor's exhaust to deflect up to 75 % of its thrust sideways: the throttle.

PADDLE-ARM-OR.name: Paddle arm with lever, 1.5 mm 304 stainless
PADDLE-ARM-OR.role: 1.5 mm stainless arm that holds the paddle; its lever is what the scissor link pushes.

PADDLE-ARM-IR.name: Paddle arm, 1.5 mm 304 stainless
PADDLE-ARM-IR.role: Second stainless arm on the paddle's other end.

PADDLE-PIN-R.name: Paddle pivot pin, 2 mm steel
PADDLE-PIN-R.role: 2 mm steel pin the paddle swings on, 8 mm below the nozzle.

PADDLE-LINK-R.name: Scissor link
PADDLE-LINK-R.role: Link from the crosshead to the +Y paddle lever.

PADDLE-L.name: Throttle paddle, alumina-silicate ceramic 20 x 28 x 4
PADDLE-L.role: Its twin on the other side, so the two side forces cancel.

PADDLE-ARM-OL.name: Paddle arm with lever, 1.5 mm 304 stainless

PADDLE-BRKT.name: Paddle bracket on the inner gimbal ring, 1.5 mm 6061 aluminium
PADDLE-BRKT.note: Wrap the plume-facing rails in stainless tape / ceramic paper.
PADDLE-BRKT.role: 1.5 mm aluminium U-bracket under the inner gimbal ring, so the paddles move with the motor.

PADDLE-XHEAD.name: Scissor crosshead
PADDLE-XHEAD.role: Slides up and down. Through the two links it opens or closes both paddles together.

SERVO-PADDLE.name: KST X08H paddle (throttle) servo, strapped to the bracket
SERVO-PADDLE.role: KST X08H (pin 4) strapped to the bracket. It moves the crosshead 50 times a second to follow the burn plan.

HORN-PADDLE.name: Servo horn (10 mm)
HORN-PADDLE.role: 10 mm horn on the throttle servo.

PADDLE-SERVO-LINK.name: Servo-to-crosshead link
PADDLE-SERVO-LINK.role: Link from the horn to the crosshead, through a slot in the bracket.

HEAT-SHIELD.name: Servo heat shield, aluminium + ceramic paper
HEAT-SHIELD.role: Aluminium plus ceramic paper under the servo, between it and the plume.

LIDAR-TFMINI.name: Benewake TFmini-S lidar, looking down
LIDAR-TFMINI.role: Benewake TFmini-S looking straight down; measures the last ~7 m to the ground and detects touchdown.

LIDAR-WINDOW.name: Replaceable 1 mm polycarbonate lidar window
LIDAR-WINDOW.role: Replaceable 1 mm polycarbonate shield that keeps exhaust soot off the lidar's lenses. Wipe it after every flight.

LIDAR-BRKT.name: Lidar bracket, CF-nylon
LIDAR-BRKT.role: Printed bracket on the liner at 315°, clear of both plumes and the paddles; its lip holds the window.

LEG-CLEVIS.name: Leg hinge clevis with 55 deg stop, CF-nylon
LEG-CLEVIS.role: Printed CF-nylon bracket bonded through a slot in the tube. Its cheeks hold the hinge pin, and its stop block catches the leg at 55°.

LEG-DOUBLER.name: Leg hinge doubler, 1/8 in ply (on the aft liner)
LEG-DOUBLER.role: 1/8 in ply pad inside the tube that the clevis tongue bonds to, spreading the landing load.

LEG-PIN.name: Leg hinge pin, 3 mm steel
LEG-PIN.role: 3 mm steel pin the leg pivots on.

LEG-SPRING.name: Leg torsion spring, ~0.15 N m
LEG-SPRING.role: About 0.15 N·m that swings the leg out in under 0.3 s once released.

LEG-INSERT.name: Leg hinge knuckle / strut plug, CF-nylon
LEG-INSERT.role: Printed knuckle around the pin, with a plug bonded into the strut.

LEG-STRUT.name: Leg strut, 8 x 7 mm pultruded carbon tube, 532 mm
LEG-STRUT.role: 532 mm of 8 x 7 mm pultruded carbon tube.

LEG-DAMPER.name: Syringe air damper barrel
LEG-DAMPER.role: Syringe-style air damper bonded to the strut tip. It soaks up the touchdown so the rocket doesn't bounce.

LEG-PLUNGER.name: Damper plunger
LEG-PLUNGER.role: Piston and rod that slide in the damper and carry the foot.

LEG-FOOT.name: Foot, TPU-95A lattice crush pad (30 mm)
LEG-FOOT.role: 30 mm TPU lattice pad, angled to sit flat at 55°; it also crushes to absorb energy.

LEG-LOOP.name: Kevlar release loop around the 4 legs, to the release pin
LEG-LOOP.role: Kevlar loop around all four folded legs, hooked over the release pin. Pulling the pin lets all four legs swing out together.
